name: Health, Water and Sanitation
summary: Research studies health risks connected to poverty, infrastructure, and access to essential services, including drinking water, sanitation, and nutrition.
overview: The agenda includes water quality and treatment, child health, nutritional outcomes, and family health decisions, using survey evidence and causal methods.

projects.title: Water Treatment, E. coli in Drinking Water, and Diarrhea: Causal Inference Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning
projects.summary: Applies double/debiased machine learning to estimate links between drinking-water contamination and child diarrhea across 25 countries.

projects.title: Intergenerational Transmission of Obesity in Mexico
projects.summary: Studies parent-adolescent obesity patterns in Mexican health-survey data, including differences by parent and child gender.
